moves.name: Define on Simple Forms
moves.signature: Establish the operation's meaning for a tractable, elementary subset of the domain.

moves.name: Isolate a Core Invariant
moves.signature: Identify a structural property that remains constant or scales predictably under the defined operation for the simple case.

moves.name: Generalize by Approximation
moves.signature: Define the operation for a broader class of inputs by treating them as the limit of a sequence of simpler inputs.

moves.name: Preserve Structure in Limit
moves.signature: Ensure a core structural property holds for the generalized operation by demonstrating its stability through the limiting process.

moves.name: Specify Operational Constraints
moves.signature: Explicitly state the conditions or class of inputs for which the new framework is valid.

moves.name: Apply a Standard Expansion
moves.signature: Employ a well-established decomposition technique from a related field to analyze the new structure.

moves.name: Identify the Anomaly
moves.signature: Recognize a new, non-classical term that emerges from applying standard tools to the unique properties of the new domain.

moves.name: Ground Anomaly in Axioms
moves.signature: Explain the origin of the novel term by tracing it back to a fundamental, defining property of the underlying system.
moves.anchor: arises from the quadratic variation [B,B]_t = t

moves.name: Leverage Probabilistic Identity
moves.signature: Justify a pathwise relationship by appealing to the average behavior or expectation-based properties of the underlying random process.

moves.name: Codify the Central Formula
moves.signature: Synthesize the core discovery into a concise, powerful equation that becomes the signature result of the new framework.

moves.name: Establish Foundational Rules
moves.signature: Define a system's behavior through a small set of self-consistent, fundamental principles or axioms.

moves.name: Import External Structure
moves.signature: Apply a well-developed formal system from one domain to provide structure and rigor to another.

moves.name: Translate Core Concepts
moves.signature: Map the components of an imported framework to the native concepts of the target domain.
moves.anchor: reinterpret the axioms in probability language

moves.name: Unify Disparate Cases
moves.signature: Demonstrate that previously distinct phenomena or models are special instances of a single, more general framework.
moves.anchor: structural unification of disparate probability traditions

moves.name: Define a Composite Object
moves.signature: Specify a central entity as a formal tuple of well-defined components and their relationships.
moves.anchor: a probability space is a triple (Ω, F, P)

moves.name: Impose Structural Constraints
moves.signature: Introduce specific rules or properties that components of the system must satisfy to ensure coherence.

moves.name: Redefine Native Concepts
moves.signature: Re-express existing concepts within the new foundational system, giving them a more rigorous or general meaning.

moves.name: Equate Operations
moves.signature: Show that a familiar operation in the target domain is equivalent to a more powerful or general operation in the source framework.

moves.name: Repurpose an Advanced Tool
moves.signature: Use a powerful construct from the source framework to solve a specific, complex problem in the target domain.

moves.name: Establish Scaling Law
moves.signature: Posit that a system's behavior at scale follows a predictable, often exponential, relationship governed by a core function.
moves.anchor: the rare-event probabilities decay exponentially with a rate function I

moves.name: Define Cost Function
moves.signature: Introduce a function that quantifies the difficulty, cost, or improbability of achieving a particular state or outcome.

moves.name: Employ Duality Transform
moves.signature: Use a mathematical transformation to switch between two complementary descriptions of a system, revealing underlying structure.
moves.anchor: I is the Legendre transform of the log-MGF

moves.name: Generalize Core Principle
moves.signature: Apply a foundational principle, previously established in a simpler context, to a more complex or abstract class of systems.
moves.anchor: Cramér's theorem: for i.i.d. sums... Sanov: for empirical measures... Donsker-Varadhan: for Markov processes

moves.name: Identify Concrete Form
moves.signature: Show that a general, abstract function or principle takes the form of a specific, well-understood entity in a particular context.
moves.anchor: the rate function is relative entropy

moves.name: Propagate Through Mapping
moves.signature: Determine the properties of a transformed system by applying a consistent rule to the properties of the original system.
moves.anchor: contraction principle (transport rate function under continuous maps)

moves.name: Establish Bounding Argument
moves.signature: Constrain the value of an unknown quantity by proving it is simultaneously greater than a lower limit and less than an upper limit.
moves.anchor: upper bound via Markov inequality; lower bound via tilted measures

moves.name: Shift Governing Framework
moves.signature: Temporarily alter the underlying rules or reference frame of a system to make a difficult-to-analyze phenomenon become typical and easier to study.

moves.name: Reframe as Optimization
moves.signature: Convert a problem of direct calculation into a search for an optimal value within a defined space of possibilities.

moves.name: Formalize Forbidden Operations
moves.signature: Introduce a new symbolic or abstract system where previously undefined operations are given rigorous meaning.
moves.anchor: gives meaning to products of distributions

moves.name: Introduce Novel Primitives
moves.signature: Define a new class of fundamental objects to represent and manipulate problematic elements of a system.

moves.name: Broaden a Proven Tool
moves.signature: Abstract the core principles from a successful but narrow method to create a more general and powerful framework.

moves.name: Substitute Symbols for Objects
moves.signature: Replace direct manipulation of complex objects with operations on a well-behaved symbolic representation.
moves.anchor: algebra of formal symbols representing irregular distributions

moves.name: Assemble from Local Rules
moves.signature: Construct a global solution or object by ensuring consistency among its local components or descriptions.

moves.name: Propose a Unifying Structure
moves.signature: Develop a comprehensive system that organizes and provides a consistent approach to a class of previously ad-hoc problems.

moves.name: Demonstrate Common Destination
moves.signature: Prove that disparate systems or processes evolve towards a single, canonical endpoint or state.

moves.name: Define an Equivalence Class
moves.signature: Group seemingly different models by demonstrating they share the same fundamental behavior under certain limits.
moves.anchor: many growth models... have the same scaling limits

moves.name: Rigorize Heuristic Knowledge
moves.signature: Replace informal, intuitive, or non-rigorous solutions with a formally proven and well-defined method.
moves.anchor: exact solution had been heuristic for decades
